package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for middleware_contains_business_orchestration: Middleware that performs domain workflows instead of cross-cutting concerns such as auth, tracing, or request enrichment.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func validateOrder(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) bool {
	total := r.Header.Get("X-Order-Total")
	if total == "" || total == "0" {
		http.Error(w, "invalid order", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return false
	}
	return true
}

func chargeCustomer(orderID, amount string) error {
	fmt.Printf("charging %s for order %s\n", amount, orderID)
	return nil
}

func sendConfirmationEmail(orderID, email string) error {
	fmt.Printf("emailing %s about order %s\n", email, orderID)
	return nil
}

func CheckoutMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if !validateOrder(w, r) {
			return
		}
		orderID := r.Header.Get("X-Order-ID")
		amount := r.Header.Get("X-Order-Total")

		if err := chargeCustomer(orderID, amount); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "payment failed", http.StatusPaymentRequired)
			return
		}
		if err := sendConfirmationEmail(orderID, "user@example.com"); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "notification failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

var _ = fmt.Println
